newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Hillary Clinton starts Africa tour in Senegal.
newsitem.headline: Hillary Clinton starts Africa tour in Senegal.

text.p: U.S. first lady Hillary Rodham Clinton and her daughter Chelsea began a six-nation goodwill tour of Africa early on Monday in the Francophone West African State of Senegal.

Mrs Clinton, who will also visit South Africa, Zimbzabwe, Tanzania, Uganda and Eritrea on her ninth solo trip outside the United States, arrived a day late after delaying her departure from Washington because of her husband President Bill Clinton's knee injury.
President Clinton suffered a torn knee tendon last Friday and left hospital after surgery on Sunday.
